manifest.description: Rewrite a Rust module's error type - signature rewrites + literal construction rewrites; ?-site conversions handled by rust.fixRound. Preflighted with code.items plus code.signature plus lsp.references.
when_to_use: a module's error type is not actionable for callers or is over-specified
migrating from a one-size error to a more granular variant set
consolidating two ad-hoc error types in a module
anti_patterns: do not use when error sites use downcast / downcast_ref - atom refuses cleanly
do not use on a public error type unless the operator supplied the dispatch-side ToolArgDefaults grant
do not combine the public-API preflight with the mutating EditSet

item_names.description: Function names whose error return signatures should change.

error_mapping.description: Map of old construction form to new construction form, e.g. {"OldErr::Bad(msg)": "NewErr::Bad { msg }"}.
